Class FoldingPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.FoldingPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
final class FoldingPanel extends JPanel
The FoldingPanel is the connection bar that can fold. Open, the mark button shows v. Folded, the mark button shows ^. The panel holds the SshConnectionPanel, the product tabs, and the SshClientTheme. A FoldingPanel.BarPick receives a press on the folded SSH button or the folded Aetheris button. The open bar places the menu above the connection fields. A one-pixel line sits under those fields. The folded bar is one row. That row shows the mark, the link word, the SSH button, the Aetheris button, a divider, and the same menu. The tab strip stays in the center in both layouts. The bar starts open. The link starts down. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#FoldingPanel

  • Field Details

    • FOLD_TIP

      static final String FOLD_TIP
      The FOLD_TIP is the tooltip while the bar is open. The text says a click folds the connection bar and the fields leave the window. The text says the canvas then uses that height. The text says ^ brings the bar back. The text says Connect folds the bar. The text says a resize while connected folds the bar. The text says Disconnect opens the bar. The text says the choice is not saved.

      The SHOW_TIP is the tooltip while the bar is folded. The text says a click shows the connection bar. The text says the remote server, the port, the user, the password, Connect, and Disconnect sit on that row. The text says Connect folds the bar. The text says a resize while connected folds the bar. The text says Disconnect opens the bar. The text says the choice is not saved.

  • Constructor Details

    • FoldingPanel

      FoldingPanel(SshConnectionPanel connection, JTabbedPane tabs, SshClientTheme theme, FoldingPanel.BarPick pick)
      The constructor builds the open bar and the folded bar. The panel uses a border layout. The theme paints this panel, the mark wrap, the field row, the open head, the folded row, and the folded head. The mark button starts as v with FOLD_TIP. A press on the mark applies FoldingPanel.Beat.MARK. The open head places the mark on the west and the connection fields in the center. The gap between those two parts is four pixels. tabRule sits on the south edge of the open head. Its preferred size and minimum size are one by one. Its maximum height stays one pixel. The constructor creates a link chip, an SSH button at index 0, and an Aetheris button at index 1. The folded divider is one pixel wide and eighteen pixels tall. The divider uses the split background. The folded left row uses a left flow layout with a six-pixel horizontal gap and a two-pixel vertical gap. The tab strip is added in the center. The theme installs the plate tab painter. showChrome() applies the open layout.
      Parameters:
      connection - The connection fields shown on the open bar.
      tabs - The product tabs. Index 0 is SSH. Index 1 is Aetheris.
      theme - The dark painter for this panel and its buttons.
      pick - The receiver for a folded SSH or Aetheris press. The constructor stores a null receiver.

    • holdShortLabel

      private static void holdShortLabel(AbstractButton button)
      The holdShortLabel method gives a short mark enough width to stay readable. A null button returns immediately. The method remembers the current preferred size, then clears the preferred, minimum, and maximum sizes. A null label is treated as an empty string. A null font uses SansSerif, plain, at twelve points. A null inset set is treated as zero on every side. An em is the width of the letter M in that font. An em below one pixel becomes one pixel. The text width is the label width plus the left and right insets. A label of two characters or fewer gains two ems. A longer label gains two ems only when the remembered width is below the text width. A remembered preferred width that is larger than that result is kept. The height is the larger of the remembered height and the font height plus the top and bottom insets. A width below one pixel becomes one pixel. A height below one pixel becomes one pixel. The preferred size and the minimum size become that width and height. The maximum width is Integer.MAX_VALUE. The maximum height stays the chosen height. The button text is left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      button - The mark button whose sizes are replaced.

    • openAfter

      static boolean openAfter(boolean open, boolean linkUp, FoldingPanel.Beat beat)
      The openAfter method decides whether the fields stay on screen. FoldingPanel.Beat.CONNECTED returns false, so the bar folds. FoldingPanel.Beat.DISCONNECTED returns true, so the bar opens. FoldingPanel.Beat.RESIZED returns false when the link is up. The same beat returns the current open value when the link is down. FoldingPanel.Beat.MARK returns the opposite of the current open value. A null beat returns the current open value.
      Parameters:
      open - The current open value. True means the fields are on screen.
      linkUp - True when the link is up.
      beat - The change that just happened.
      Returns:
      The next open value.

    • linkAfter

      static boolean linkAfter(boolean linkUp, FoldingPanel.Beat beat)
      The linkAfter method decides whether the link stays up. FoldingPanel.Beat.CONNECTED returns true. FoldingPanel.Beat.DISCONNECTED returns false. FoldingPanel.Beat.RESIZED returns the current value. FoldingPanel.Beat.MARK returns the current value. A null beat returns the current value.
      Parameters:
      linkUp - The current link value. True means the link is up.
      beat - The change that just happened.
      Returns:
      The next link value.

    • applyMenuFont

      void applyMenuFont(int points)
      The applyMenuFont method sizes the menu from the font control. A missing menu returns immediately. A point size below one returns immediately. A missing menu font becomes SansSerif, plain, at the requested size. An existing menu font is derived as plain at that size. paintMenuFont(Component, Font) applies the font to the bar and to the menu rows. fitMenuWidth() clears stale sizes and may grow the frame. seatPlateFont(int) stores the same size on SSH, Aetheris, and the tabs. The menu is then revalidated and repainted. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-144
      Parameters:
      points - The live font-control size, in points.

    • seatPlateFont

      private void seatPlateFont(int points)
      The seatPlateFont method applies the control-bar size to SSH, Aetheris, and the tabs. A size below eight becomes eight. A size above thirty-six becomes thirty-six. The clamped size is stored in platePoints. The face is SansSerif, plain, at that size. The preferred, minimum, and maximum sizes of both buttons are cleared. The panel is revalidated and repainted. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-164
      Parameters:
      points - The requested control-bar size, in points.

    • paintMenuFont

      private void paintMenuFont(Component node, Font font)
      The paintMenuFont method sets one font on a menu component. A null component returns immediately. A null font returns immediately. A JMenu then receives the same font on every component it keeps. That pass includes the rows under the menu. Any other container sets the font only on children that are menu items. Those menu items receive the same call. A child that is not a menu item is left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      node - The bar, the menu, or one row.
      font - The live menu face.

    • fitMenuWidth

      private void fitMenuWidth()
      The fitMenuWidth method sizes the menu from the live font. A missing menu returns immediately. Each menu component that is a Swing component has its minimum, preferred, and maximum sizes cleared. A menu popup in that first pass also has its preferred size cleared and is invalidated. The second pass measures each Swing component. A missing preferred size is treated as one by one. A preferred width or height below one becomes one. The minimum size and the preferred size become that width and height. The maximum width stays that width. The maximum height is 32767. The widths are added into one sum. A menu popup is measured again after that size is set. A popup with a positive preferred width and height is given that size. A popup with a missing or non-positive preferred size is left unset. A side sibling uses west, east, line start, or line end. The parent must be using a border layout. North, south, and center siblings are not counted. A side sibling with a positive preferred width adds that width. The method then climbs from the menu parent up to the frame. Each container inset on that climb adds its left and right padding. The frame insets add their left and right padding. The needed width is the menu sum plus that chrome. The climb stops when the window is not a frame. The width floor starts at 640. The height floor starts at 480. A frame minimum that is already larger replaces that floor on that axis. When the needed width is above the width floor, the frame minimum becomes the needed width and the height floor. When the current frame width is positive and below the needed width, the frame is resized to the needed width. That resize uses the current height when it is already at least the height floor. A shorter frame is raised to the height floor. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-150

    • apply

      void apply(FoldingPanel.Beat beat)
      The apply method records one beat. linkAfter(boolean, FoldingPanel.Beat) updates the stored link. openAfter(boolean, boolean, FoldingPanel.Beat) chooses the next open value. An unchanged open value returns without painting. A changed value is stored. showChrome() then rebuilds the visible bar. Connecting does not call this method.
      Parameters:
      beat - The change that just happened.

    • showFields

      void showFields()
      The showFields method opens the connection fields. An already open bar returns immediately. The stored link word is left unchanged. showChrome() rebuilds the open bar. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-132

    • noteSpan

      void noteSpan(int width, int height)
      The noteSpan method watches the frame size. A width of zero or less returns immediately. A height of zero or less returns immediately. The first positive size is stored and does not fold the bar. A later call stores the new size. A width change or a height change applies FoldingPanel.Beat.RESIZED. An unchanged size does not apply a beat.
      Parameters:
      width - The frame width, in pixels.
      height - The frame height, in pixels.

    • showLink

      void showLink(String word)
      The showLink method sets the word on the folded row. A null word becomes an empty string. The exact text Connected paints the green chip. Any other word is passed through Vt100StatusLine.west(String, String, String). The second argument and the third argument of that call are empty strings. The chip stores the resulting text and the green flag.
      Parameters:
      word - The link word. A null value is shown as empty text.

    • syncPlates

      void syncPlates()
      The syncPlates method matches the folded buttons to the tab strip. The SSH button is always enabled. The SSH button is selected when the selected tab index is 0. The Aetheris button is enabled only when the strip has more than one tab and index 1 is enabled. The Aetheris button is selected when the selected tab index is 1.

    • plateButton

      private JButton plateButton(String label, int index)
      The plateButton method builds one folded product button. The theme installs the plate face with the button unselected. The label SSH gets the tooltip Show the SSH terminal. The label Aetheris gets the tooltip Show the Aetheris canvas. The mux has to be up. Any other label gets no tooltip. A press calls FoldingPanel.BarPick.pressed(int) when a receiver was stored. A null receiver skips that call. The press then calls syncPlates().
      Parameters:
      label - The button text.
      index - The index passed to FoldingPanel.BarPick.pressed(int).
      Returns:
      The new button.

    • paintPlate

      private void paintPlate(JButton button, boolean selected, boolean enabled)
      The paintPlate method updates one folded button. The enabled flag is applied first. The theme then installs the plate face for the selected flag.
      Parameters:
      button - The SSH button or the Aetheris button.
      selected - True when this button matches the selected tab.
      enabled - True when the button accepts a press.

    • showChrome

      private void showChrome()
      The showChrome method rebuilds the visible bar from the stored open flag. The mark text becomes mark(boolean). holdShortLabel(AbstractButton) sizes that button. An open bar uses FOLD_TIP. A tab strip that is still using FoldingPanel.HiddenTabs gets the plate tab painter again. The mark returns to the north of its wrap. The menu returns to the north of the open head. A folded head that is still on this panel is removed. The open head is added on the north when it is not already there. A folded bar uses SHOW_TIP. A tab strip that is not using FoldingPanel.HiddenTabs is given that painter. The folded left row is cleared. The row then adds the mark, the link chip, SSH, Aetheris, and the divider, in that order. The menu moves to the center of the folded head. An open head that is still on this panel is removed. The folded head is added on the north when it is not already there. The tab strip is added in the center when it is not already on this panel. A stored platePoints value above zero is applied again. placeThink() moves the spinner and clock. syncPlates() refreshes the two product buttons. The panel is revalidated and repainted.

    • seatThink

      void seatThink(JComponent cluster)
      The seatThink method stores the thinking cluster. SshConnectionPanel.holdThink(JComponent) keeps that cluster for the open bar. placeThink() moves it to the row that is visible now. A null cluster clears the stored cluster. // @aa-sdd PK-1099 docs/specs/common/formal-plan.spec.md FINESSE:f-180
      Parameters:
      cluster - The spinner and clock, or null.

    • placeThink

      private void placeThink()
      The placeThink method moves one cluster between the two bars. A null cluster returns immediately. An open bar calls SshConnectionPanel.parkThink(). A folded bar places the cluster on the east side of the folded head.

    • seat

      private static void seat(Component child, Container parent, String where)
      The seat method moves a child onto a parent. A null child returns immediately. A null parent returns immediately. A child that is already on that parent stays there. A child that has another parent is removed from that parent first. The child is then added with the given layout constraint.
      Parameters:
      child - The component to move.
      parent - The container that should hold the child.
      where - The layout constraint passed to the parent.
